Constructs MessageOverlay: sets non-opaque and disables mouse interception.

detaileddescription.para: The component starts hidden (addChildComponent in the parent). Visibility is managed entirely by jam::Animator::toggleFade().

briefdescription.para: Shows an arbitrary message for a configurable duration.

detaileddescription.para: Fades in immediately, then starts the auto-hide timer for durationMs milliseconds.

parameterdescription.para: The message to display (may be multi-line).
How long to show the message before fading out. Defaults to messageDelayMs (5000 ms).

simplesect.para: Calls toFront(false) after fade-in to guarantee sibling z-order lift.

briefdescription.para: Paints the semi-transparent background and centred message text.

detaileddescription.para: Font is read from the config tree on every paint pass (hot-reload safe). Background colour from juce::TabbedComponent::backgroundColourId, text colour from juce::TabbedButtonBar::frontTextColourId.

parameterdescription.para: JUCE graphics context for this paint pass.

briefdescription.para: Auto-hide timer callback: stops the timer and fades out.
Semi-transparent overlay for transient status messages (text-only mode).

detaileddescription.para: Inherits juce::Component for rendering and juce::Timer (private) for the auto-hide delay. All display logic is inline; there is no separate .cpp.
